about: A review search on a pool worker that is silent but answers 'isready' is waited for, not abandoned at the 20 s silence ceiling; one that answers nothing is still abandoned there. Graded by gate 246 at kunal761 (pool 3), a Worker wrapper holding one search's output for 24 s, readyok let through ('alive') or held too ('dead'). NOT COVERED: his game 29 itself in the browser (about 300 s, a probe; gate 239 walks it from its recorded output); the analysis worker's sfEval1 path (unchanged); his phone.

breaks.name: the-silent-search-is-not-asked
breaks.why: no liveness ping is ever sent, so a live search silent for 20 s is abandoned and its group retried again (the tree before)

breaks.name: the-answer-is-not-counted-as-progress
breaks.why: the ping is sent and answered, but its readyok is swallowed without counting as progress, so the live search is still abandoned

breaks.name: asking-keeps-a-dead-worker-alive
breaks.why: sending the ping counts as progress instead of its answer, so a worker that answers nothing is never abandoned
